text: Unlike a standard ESN tuned for the echo state property (rho < 1), the CPG lab deliberately builds a supra-critical reservoir with spectral radius above 1 (rho = 1.25).
explanation: True. The lab sets RHO = 1.25, described in the code as 'above stability: chaotic reservoir'. A rho > 1 reservoir has intrinsic, self-sustaining (chaotic) dynamics that FORCE can sculpt into a stable target rhythm, the opposite of the rho < 1 fading-memory regime used for ordinary input-driven tasks.
